title: Rotational Work-Energy Theorem

variables.W_{\\text{net}}: Net work done by external torques
variables.\\tau_{\\text{net}}: Net external torque about the rotation axis
variables.I: Moment of inertia about the fixed rotation axis

assumptions: Rigid body rotating about a fixed axis in an inertial reference frame
Work evaluated between initial angle theta_1 and final angle theta_2
validity_conditions: Valid for any net torque function whether constant or angle-dependent
common_misuse: Multiplying torque by time instead of angular displacement to compute work
Confusing rotational work with angular impulse (tau * dt)
